project.name: chapter-20-volume-3-capstone-autonomous-ops-agent
project.description: Volume 3 Capstone -- Acme Retail's Autonomous Ops Agent. Composes every mechanism this volume built: narrow-scope monitor specialists (Ch.15), a guardrail that blocks an autonomous action outside any agent's own reasoning (Ch.18), a connected trace across every agent and decision (Ch.19), and an MCP-exposed capability (Ch.11-14's hand-written protocol stand-in) -- to monitor Acme's own operations and act within its guardrails, escalating to a human the moment its own limits say it must. The capstone incident deliberately exercises the same "composition doesn't inherit correctness" lesson as volume2_1 Ch.20, now at multi-agent scale: two monitor specialists independently flagging the same SKU leads the orchestrator to attempt a second reorder that the guardrail was never told to expect, and blocks anyway.
